purpose: Define the minimum honest, accessible, evidence-backed public presentation of an Ego Hygiene repository.

slots.title: Repository identity banner
slots.description: A repository-owned, checksum-bound banner projection with meaningful alt text and a readable textual fallback.
checks: asset is repository-owned or pinned to a released Identity package
alt text identifies the repository rather than describing decoration
narrow, light, dark, high-contrast, no-image, and no-network behavior remain readable

slots.title: Purpose
slots.description: A concise statement of what the repository is for and who it serves.
checks: purpose is repository-authored
purpose does not claim capabilities absent from the represented revision

slots.title: Maturity and status
slots.description: A visible, truthful lifecycle and support status.
checks: experimental, incubating, archived, unsupported, or pre-release status is not hidden

slots.title: Support boundary
slots.description: The support path, support limitations, and security-reporting boundary.
checks: support and security destinations resolve or limitations are stated honestly

slots.title: Canonical navigation
slots.description: Stable links to the canonical documentation, architecture, contributing, security, license, and release surfaces that apply.
checks: links are repository-relative or canonical HTTPS destinations
missing destinations are omitted rather than fabricated

slots.title: Evidence-backed badges
slots.description: Badges link to evidence for a specific workflow, release, package, license, documentation, or Hygiene profile state.
checks: each badge has a useful text fallback and evidence destination
absence or stale evidence never renders as passing
badge labels do not imply legal certification or universal compliance

slots.title: Installation or access
slots.description: The shortest truthful path to install, consume, read, or access the repository output.
checks: commands and destinations match the represented revision

slots.title: Local development
slots.description: Prerequisites and canonical local setup commands.
checks: commands are repository-owned and do not rely on undocumented personal state

slots.title: Documentation
slots.description: The canonical user and reference documentation entry point.
checks: documentation links resolve or the README honestly defines the complete supported surface

slots.title: Validation
slots.description: Canonical quality commands and linked CI evidence.
checks: validation claims resolve to commands or immutable evidence

slots.title: Architecture
slots.description: A concise architecture entry point and ownership boundary.
checks: generated orientation is distinguished from canonical architecture source

slots.title: Contributing
slots.description: Contribution expectations or an explicit statement that contributions are not currently accepted.
checks: the contribution path reflects the repository's actual policy

slots.title: License and notices
slots.description: The repository license and applicable third-party notice boundary.
checks: license claims match checked-in or released material

slots.title: Security reporting
slots.description: The applicable security-reporting path or an explicit statement that private reporting is unavailable.
checks: security guidance does not promise an unsupported response or expose private contact data

slots.title: Generated content ownership
slots.description: Generated sections identify their canonical source, generator, update path, and safe manual-edit boundary.
checks: generated content does not silently become canonical truth

ownership.hygiene: policy, applicability, slot semantics, evidence states, and badge claim limits
ownership.identity: approved banner and badge visual assets, variants, manifests, checksums, and renderer-neutral descriptors
ownership.holon: new-repository README blueprint and generated-region composition
ownership.egolint: lint rules, applicability evaluation, diagnostics, and normalized conformance reports
ownership.relay: reusable CI orchestration and evidence transport
ownership.pace: reviewable, reversible adoption plans and pull requests for existing repositories
ownership.observatory: read-only fleet aggregation, freshness, and conformance presentation
ownership.repository: purpose, status, commands, links, licenses, support state, exceptions, and final review
